Overview

Jammu is a city in Jammu and Kashmir with a population of 700,000. The winter capital of Jammu and Kashmir, known for its ancient temples, Vaishno Devi shrine, and as a gateway to the Kashmir Valley. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
